debt.portfolioForecast: The 2026–2030 forecast covers the debt portfolio outstanding on 31 December 2025. It is a repayment schedule for that portfolio, rather than a complete forecast of future government budgets.
debt.source: Data: Ministry of Finance of Georgia. The figures cover government debt, which has a narrower scope than public or state debt.
debt.comparability: When comparing years, consider the 2019 change in the accounting of budgetary organisations and the 2022 change in which state-owned enterprises fall within general government.
debt.missingRates: Unpublished rates remain missing; they have not been replaced with zero.
